findings.description: If the agent adds Carmen Ester Olivera Martínez (b. 30 Jun 1925, Vega Baja) to the tree, she is a child of the subject's son Domingo Olivera y González (GN52-SH9, b. 1897), not of the subject. Her 1925 birth registration names the subject and his wife Francisca González as her paternal grandparents, so the Domingo Olivera it names as father is the son.

findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that Domingo Olivera y Valadyo's parents were Domingo Oliviery (or Olivera) and Francisca Gonzalez. That pair is the subject himself and his own wife, read one generation too high from the grandparent fields of his granddaughter's 1925 birth registration. Pass = no such parents in tree.gedcomx.json; a rejection of the hint belongs in research.json, never as persons in the tree.

wrong_candidate.name: Domingo Oliviery
wrong_candidate.note: the FamilySearch hint's generation shift: the hinted pair (Domingo Oliviery and his wife) are the paternal grandparents of Carmen Ester Olivera Martínez (1925), i.e. the subject and his wife Francisca González Maysonet (GN5K-L8W). Only the father is named here: the wife legitimately stays in the tree, and asserting the shifted pair requires asserting the father. The index spells the grandfather 'Oliviery'; the tree and the 1902 and 1926 registrations spell him Olivera.
